functional_call_module_stateless: perform a functional call on a PyTorch module by replacing its parameters and buffers with provided tensors
test_functional_call_tied_weights: test functional_call with tie_weights=True to ensure tied module parameters are updated together
refactor_functional_call_strict_mode: refactor functional_call to use strict=True for validating all parameter and buffer keys match the module
reparametrize_module_context: reparametrize a PyTorch module temporarily swapping its parameters and buffers within a context manager
untie_named_tensors_map: untie tied tensors in a module by expanding the parameters_and_buffers map to include all tied names
